projectName: Environment Isolation — Two Databases, Two Data-Daemons

transitions.note: Peer review by Rhea (3-model Socratic debate)
Approach B: Staging branch pattern — develop deploys to develop Railway (staging), main deploys to p

question: How should we properly isolate develop and production environments for data-daemon, including separate databases, deploy pipelines, and migration workflows, using our existing toolkit (Railway, Supabase, GitHub Actions, railguey, cerebro-migrations)?
context: Greenmark Cerebro has two Supabase instances: production (wwmcgtyngnziepeynccz) and dev (izmuckuepryqneebwwol). Both exist but currently both Railway environments (develop + production) point to the production database. data-daemon deploys to production via GitHub Actions on push to develop branch. There is no automated deploy to the develop Railway environment. Session 34 proved the danger: setting develop's DATABASE_URL to production caused develop workers to steal and fail production extraction jobs. The team is one engineer (Daniel) plus AI agents. The toolkit includes: railguey (Railway MCP with multi-account support for develop/production), cerebro-migrations (Supabase CLI for DDL), cerebro-builder (session orchestration), cerebro-docs (deployment workflows). Guardrail GR-ENV-001 now requires environment isolation. This research should produce the concrete wiring plan.
